subject.title: fix: bind exe.dev deletion to exact claims

question: Should this PR require exact-head funded exe.dev create/use/unowned-deny/destroy zero-residue proof before merge, or should a maintainer explicitly waive that provider proof gate?
rationale: The patch changes a destructive provider security boundary and the author states the exact-head funded provider proof is still unavailable, so automation cannot safely substitute local tests for maintainer proof intent.

options.title: Require exact-head provider proof

options.title: Explicitly waive live proof

options.title: Pause for compatibility policy
